name: sciehub
description: SCIEHub - a GitHub-style materials sharing platform for SCIErs

scripts.predev: npm run build -w @sciehub/shared && npm run build -w @sciehub/web && npm run db:migrate:local
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev -w @sciehub/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sciehub/shared && npm run build -w @sciehub/web
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sciehub/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
